label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF MARK A. HOFFMAN
text: Mark A. Hoffman, of Lederach, Pennsylvania, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of April 5, 2021; and a rule having been issued and served upon him requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that Mark A. Hoffman is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
